entries.subject: Willowbrook: Thatched roofs, reed ponds and one very loud goblin problem. A gentle place to learn your trade.
Mossbarrow: Hedgerows, haystacks and the best market for seeds and livestock in the realm. Something huge roots in the woods.
Saltmere: Gulls, rope and tar. Smugglers work the docks, and the fish run fat in the cold water.
Ironpeak Hold: A hold of hammers cut into the mountain. Rich veins, frozen tarns and hungry trolls.
Gloomfen: Lantern light on black water. The dead walk here, and the witch of the fen walks with them.
Emberfall Citadel: A citadel on a living volcano. Only the finest adventurers come back from the Wyrm.
Skyreach: Rope bridges between floating peaks. The monks guard secrets older than the realm.
The Hollow Crown: A drowned throne room under a violet sky. The last road ends here.
